hierarchy.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none uppercase
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none uppercase

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Mode A) for campaigns, generous spacing, optical alignment.

motion_and_interactions.global: Lenis for smooth scrolling. Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveals.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Fade up with blur-in effect on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, organic kinetic typography for the 80/20 pull quote.

components_and_sections.name: HeroSection
components_and_sections.layout: Two-column asymmetric. Left: Staggered text reveal. Right: Sticky comic book portrait.
components_and_sections.visuals: Hero image right aligned. Eyebrow, massive H1, and body text on left. Use glassmorphism on text if overlapping.
components_and_sections.animations: Image scales up slowly (parallax). Text lines slide up staggeringly.

components_and_sections.name: TheFirst90Days
components_and_sections.visuals: A glowing red vertical line (Tracing Beam aesthetic) connecting three nodes. Each node represents a 30-day block.
components_and_sections.animations: The line draws itself down on scroll. Content nodes fade in as the line reaches them.

components_and_sections.name: TheWorkSplit
components_and_sections.visuals: Massive '80' and '20' numerals in Bebas Neue. A fast marquee running across the background containing the pull quote in outline text. Left side dark gray, right side red or high contrast.
components_and_sections.animations: Numerals scale up on intersection. Marquee continuous scroll.

components_and_sections.name: ThreeCampaigns
components_and_sections.visuals: Cards for each campaign. Glassmorphism cards with 1px border. Dark, terminal-like aesthetic. Campaign 1 uses monospace font elements for the 'commit' theme. Campaign 2 uses a dark red abstract vibe. Campaign 3 uses a photo.

components_and_sections.name: TheUltimateVision
components_and_sections.visuals: Parallax background of F1 car. Dark overlay (bg-black/50) with heavy vignette. Massive headline 'DASH0 ON A FERRARI'. Text blocks staggered.
components_and_sections.animations: Slow zoom on background image. Text elements float in with high tension.

components_and_sections.name: WhyDash0
components_and_sections.visuals: Motorcycle racer background image with dark overlay. High contrast white text. Signature at the bottom.
components_and_sections.animations: Fade in on scroll. Simple, elegant closing.

hero_image.description: Comic book style portrait with red background. Used in Hero Section.

ferrari_f1_image.description: Red Formula 1 car speeding. Used in The Ultimate Vision section.

motorcycle_racer_image.description: Motorcycle racer leaning into a turn. Used in Why Dash0 section.

f1_close_up.description: Close up of racing car front. Used in The Ultimate Vision or Work Split.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive/key elements must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-heading').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Bebas Neue and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts via next/font or standard HTML link.
Install lenis for smooth scrolling, wrap the main app with a Lenis provider component.
Ensure dark mode is locked for this landing page since it's a cinematic dark theme.
Follow the layout rules strictly: use generous paddings (py-32).
Implement the 'Tracing Beam' effect for the First 90 Days timeline using Framer Motion.
Use react-fast-marquee for the kinetic text in The Work Split.
Never use generic default Shadcn looks; strip them down and restyle with black, white, and red.
Use the exact media URLs provided in the media section. DO NOT use placeholders.
All headings should use Bebas Neue, uppercase, tracking-tight.
